facts: Parties: Northgate Robotics Ltd (Buyer), Whitlock Logistics plc (Seller); the Company is Juniper Systems Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 21 March 2026; Closing is scheduled for 24 April 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 12 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 48 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 5 years after Closing.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 150 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 21 March 2026), either party may terminate.

Section 8.4 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 20% of the Purchase Price, being $31,250,000. The Purchase Price is $125,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Ashcombe Technologies Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 2 October 2026.
